results.text: The study evaluates a graph‑indexing and dual‑level retrieval system on four corpora—Agriculture, Computer Science, Legal and a mixed set. Across Agriculture, CS and Legal the proposed method outperforms the baseline, while on the mixed collection the baseline has a slight edge, so universal superiority is not claimed. The approach supports incremental updates, allowing new data to be added without rebuilding the entire graph. Limitations include the mixed‑dataset result where the baseline remains marginally better.
